content_sections.heading: Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational, professional teaching and subject-specific eligibility requirements prescribed for their chosen teaching post. The recruitment covers primary school, graduate primary, high school, physical education and computer science teaching positions. The required qualifications vary according to the post and subject. Depending on the position, relevant qualifications may include PUC or Class 12, a Diploma, Graduation and prescribed professional teacher-training qualifications. Applicants must verify the exact degree, subject combination, teacher-training and eligibility-test requirements in the applicable official notification.

content_sections.text: The recruitment process includes a competitive written examination and other prescribed stages according to the teaching post. Candidates may also be required to undergo document verification and satisfy applicable eligibility and reservation conditions. The exact examination pattern, marking scheme, merit weightage and post-specific selection requirements should be checked against the official recruitment rules and examination notification. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Karnataka School Education Department website at schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in . Open the relevant Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 application link. Select the applicable region, recruitment and teaching post. Complete registration using the required details. Fill in personal, educational and other requested information. Upload the necessary documents in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable application fee within the permitted period. Review the application details and submit the form. Download and save the application confirmation for future reference. Candidates covered by the Hassan District extension notice should complete their applications by 16 November 2026. Other candidates should confirm the applicable revised deadline from their district-wise recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Correction
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Gazette notice dated 26 October 2026 provides an application correction deadline of 18 November 2026 for the recruitment covered by the Hassan District notification. Candidates who have already submitted their applications should check the official portal for the permitted correction facility and review their submitted details carefully. The notice does not specify which application fields can be edited or whether any additional correction fee applies.

faq.question: Q1. What is the latest last date for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official Gazette notice dated 26 October 2026 extends the online application deadline to 16 November 2026. Candidates from other districts should verify the applicable deadline in their respective notices.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies have been announced for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15,000 vacancies across five posts: Graduate Primary Teacher, Assistant Master, Primary School Teacher, Physical Education Teacher, and Computer Science Teacher.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application correction last date?
faq.answer: The last date for application correction under the Hassan District extension notice is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should generally have completed 12th/PUC, Diploma, Degree, or Graduation, with post-wise qualification varying by post and subject; exact post-wise requirements are not specified in the sources available for this article and should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years old, with 3 years' relaxation for 2A/2B/3A/3B category candidates and 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST category candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹750 for General and Backward Class candidates, and ₹500 for SC, ST, and Specially Gifted (PwD) candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Through the official website schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in, by completing registration, filling in the application form, uploading documents, and paying the fee online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A written examination followed by other prescribed stages such as document verification; some sources also mention a physical efficiency test for specific posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Karnataka Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Reported as approximately ₹44,425 to ₹99,400 per month by one source; this figure is not independently confirmed and should be verified from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How are the vacancies divided regionally?
faq.answer: 6,967 posts are reserved for the Kalyana Karnataka region and 8,033 posts for the Non-Kalyana Karnataka region.
